en.title: Claude-Mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every AI Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,614 | Your coding agent forgets everything between sessions, forcing you to repeat yourself. Claude-Mem runs a background observer to **capture session activity**, compress it with AI, and inject **relevant context** into your next session automatically.

zh.title: Claude-Mem：让所有人造智能助手拥有跨会话持久记忆的神级插件
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,614 | 你的编程助手每次关掉就会“失忆”，让你不得不一遍遍重复同样的话。Claude-Mem 在后台默默当你的“小秘书”，**自动记录干活过程**，用 AI 提炼精华，并在你开启新对话时**精准喂给助手**。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), allowing you to partition a single physical GPU into isolated pieces. Instead of wasting money on a full GPU for a small AI model or struggling to run multiple models on one device without interference, you can now **right-size your hardware** and safely pack **more models onto a single instance**. This dramatically improves cost-efficiency and performance for enterprise AI workloads.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理现在支持多实例 GPU，以最大化 GPU 利用率
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理现在支持英伟达多实例 GPU（MIG），允许把一块物理 GPU 切成多个相互独立的独立小块。你不用再为一个小小的 AI 模型浪费一整块昂贵的 GPU，或者在单个设备上硬塞多个模型却担心它们互相干扰。这项功能帮你**按需分配硬件**，在单台机器上**塞入更多模型**，从而大幅省钱并提升性能。

en.title: Can startup founders still find a way out in Personal Agents?
en.summary: Personal AI agents are heating up, but many believe big tech companies will dominate this space, leaving **no room for startups**. However, the real excitement lies in building value **beyond foundational models**, helping startups escape the trap of merely reselling tokens and build independent competitive edges.

zh.title: 创业者做个人智能助手，到底还有没有活路？
zh.summary: 个人智能助手现在特别火，但很多人觉得大厂才能通吃，**创业者根本没戏**。不过，真正让人兴奋的是，这类产品的价值可以长在基础大模型之外，让创业公司有机会**摆脱沦为分销商**的命运，在垂直领域找到自己的生存空间。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agents
en.summary: Tech giants GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pooled their expertise to outline **15 design patterns** for building reliable AI agent systems. These patterns help developers manage complex tasks, ensure data integrity, and **reduce errors** when multiple AI agents work together on software development and enterprise workflows.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合整理AI智能体设计的15种模式
zh.summary: 科技巨头GitHub、谷歌和西门子联手整理出了**15种设计模式**，专门用来教大家怎么造出靠谱的AI智能体系统。这些模式能帮开发者在处理复杂任务时保证数据不出错，并且在多个AI一起干活时**减少翻车率**。

en.title: max-sixty/worktrunk: A CLI tool for Git worktrees designed for parallel AI agents
en.summary: ⭐ 11,991 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool that makes **Git worktrees** as easy to use as regular branches. It solves the clunky user experience of managing multiple project directories, making it effortless to run **multiple AI agents** in parallel without them stepping on each other's toes.

zh.title: max-sixty/worktrunk：专为并行 AI 智能体设计的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,991 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，能让 **Git 工作树** 的使用像普通分支一样简单。它解决了管理多个项目目录时的繁琐体验，让你能够轻松地同时运行 **多个 AI 智能体** 而不用担心它们互相干扰。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, an open simulation framework designed to study robot learning in a controlled environment. The system pairs a simulated robot arm with blocks on a tabletop, enabling automatic generation of tasks and demonstrations without tedious teleoperation. It helps scientists test how models generalize, evaluate high-level reasoning, and study actions in a reproducible setting.

zh.title: 玩具积木世界：让机器人学习更聪明的新沙盒
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了名为 **ToyBlocks** 的开源仿真框架，用来在一个可控环境中研究机器人学习。这个系统将模拟机械臂和桌上的方块结合起来，能够不用人工手动遥控就自动生成任务和演示。它能帮助科学家测试模型泛化能力、评估高阶推理，并在可重复的环境中研究机器人的各种动作。

en.title: Silicon Valley Chinese Team Beats DeepSeek to Launch Next-Gen Agent Harness
en.summary: DeepSeek recently proposed a Super-agent concept to solve human attention bottlenecks, but a Silicon Valley Chinese team named AFK AI already put a similar multi-worker architecture into their open-source product Comma months ago. By using a single router to manage multiple background workers, the system lets users handle complex, multi-task workflows through a single conversational interface while keeping long-term memory intact.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人团队造出下一代超级智能体架构
zh.summary: DeepSeek最近提出了超级智能体理念来解决人类注意力不够用的问题，而一家硅谷华人团队AFK AI几个月前就把类似的架构做进了开源产品Comma里。它通过一个主脑统筹多个后台干活的AI，让用户只用面对一个对话框就能同时搞定各种复杂任务，还能记住历史经验。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Environments
en.summary: Researchers introduced **Harness-S**, a clever training method for AI agents that solves tricky execution failures by using a pool of alternative testing environments called **sibling harnesses**. Instead of trying to find one perfect environment, it lets the AI learn from different rescue environments when its usual approach fails, successfully boosting its performance on tough benchmarks like AppWorld and SWE-Gym.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用“兄弟环境”来训练更聪明的AI智能体
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名为 **Harness-S** 的新型AI智能体训练方法，通过引入一组被称为“兄弟环境”的辅助测试工具来解决AI在执行任务时的常见失败。当原本的测试环境行不通时，它会巧妙地利用这些**备用环境**来引导AI学习，从而在 AppWorld 和 SWE-Gym 等复杂基准测试中显著**提升了表现**。

en.title: Tech Stocks Plunge as AI Bubble Hits Reality Check
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session in months, wiping out over **$2.5 trillion** in market value. This sudden drop was triggered by worries over **speculative bubble** risks and the rising political pushback against AI's massive resource consumption.

zh.title: 科技股遭遇暴跌，AI泡沫迎来现实考验
zh.summary: 纳斯达克指数创下了数月来最惨的一天，市值瞬间蒸发超过 **2.5万亿美元**。这次大跌主要是因为市场开始担忧 **投机泡沫** 破裂，加上老百姓和地方政府对AI大肆消耗水电资源的反对情绪越来越强烈。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open-source 6G and 5G tools, including Aerial and Sionna, have **surpassed 1 million downloads** worldwide as adoption grows rapidly. Researchers are using these platforms to develop **AI-native 6G networks** that improve robot response times, enhance signal reception, and optimize energy consumption. This open-source ecosystem is bridging the gap between simulation and real-world wireless experiments.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具如何帮助研究人员打造下一代 6G 网络
zh.summary: 英伟达的 Aerial 和 Sionna 等开源 6G 与 5G 工具在全球的下载量已经**突破 100 万次**，应用范围正在快速扩大。研究人员正利用这些平台开发**人工智能原生 6G 网络**，用来提升机器人的反应速度、改善信号接收效果并降低能耗。这一开源生态系统正在把电脑模拟和现实世界的无线实验紧密结合起来。

en.title: AI-generated complaints are overwhelming UK public bodies and businesses
en.summary: UK public bodies and businesses are struggling with an onslaught of **AI-generated correspondence**, a phenomenon known as "AI clog." While chatbots allow everyday people to easily draft complex, formal-sounding complaints or legal challenges, these **lengthy and repetitive messages** are creating massive workloads and exhausting human staff who are legally required to review and respond to them.

zh.title: AI生成的投诉信正在压垮英国的公共机构和企业
zh.summary: 英国的公共机构和企业正面临着一波由**AI生成的信件**带来的汪洋大海，这种现象被称为“AI堵塞”。虽然聊天机器人让普通人能轻松起草复杂的、看似非常正式的投诉或法律挑战，但这些**又长又重复的信息**带来了巨大的工作量，让必须依法审核并回复它们的员工苦不堪言。

en.title: Midterm elections deal a blow to data centers and Elon Musk, prompting a policy shift from OpenAI
en.summary: Recent midterm election results show a strong voter backlash against **data centers**, creating new roadblocks for tech giants and Elon Musk. As communities push back against secretive and resource-heavy projects, companies like **OpenAI** are already scrambling to change their approach by dropping non-disclosure agreements and promising more transparency.

zh.title: 美国中期选举重挫数据中心与马斯克，倒逼OpenAI急忙修改政策
zh.summary: 最近的中期选举结果显示，选民对**数据中心**的强烈反对浪潮正在涌现，这给科技巨头和埃隆·马斯克带来了新的阻碍。面对社区对隐秘且耗能项目的抵制，像**OpenAI**这样的公司已经开始手忙脚乱地改变策略，放弃保密协议并承诺更加透明。

en.title: I tried NYT Cooking's new AI assistant: It saved my dinner but almost ruined my cake
en.summary: The popular recipe app NYT Cooking has introduced an **AI assistant** to help users customize recipes on the fly. After testing it with various ingredient swaps and equipment changes, the author found it brilliantly practical for solving weeknight cooking dilemmas, though it still requires a **careful human eye** to avoid potential mistakes like incorrect measurements.

zh.title: 我试用了纽约时报烹饪频道的AI助手：它拯救了我的晚餐，却差点毁了我的蛋糕
zh.summary: 热门菜谱应用NYT Cooking推出了一款**AI助手**，能帮用户随时随地修改菜谱。经过各种食材替换和厨具转换的实测，作者发现它在解决下班后的做饭难题时非常实用，不过使用时还是得**仔细盯着**，以免遇到分量算错之类的小翻车。
